item.title: Thursday Drive Edition, Oct 15
item.description:
A 20-minute drive-time edition of Gumshoe News Radio for Thursday, October 15, 2026. Preview draft built Wednesday night; the morning run refreshes it with fresh news. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
Chapters: 0:00 Cold Open & Weather 1:44 US News 3:58 Surprise Factoid 4:16 International 6:22 Markets In Depth 9:41 Technology 10:53 Artificial Intelligence 12:45 Cybersecurity 14:23 Surprise Factoid 14:38 From Your X Feed 16:23 Local News & Events 17:28 Uplifting Story
Sources: - NWS api.weather.gov forecast for 42.8435,-71.3809 - AP, "How major US stock indexes fared Wednesday 10/14/2026"; AP Morning Wire Oct 14; AP live midterm updates Oct 14 - Reuters via financialnewsletter.com, "Nasdaq ends sharply lower as hot inflation data stirs rate-hike worries"; theclosingprint.net and stocks.pkladog.com closing recaps Oct 14 (sectors, yields, DXY, gold, silver, BTC) - Newsquawk US Market Wrap Oct 14 (rate-hike odds, CoreWeave bonds) - Investing.com, "U.S. stock futures fall as hot inflation revives Fed hike concerns" (futures as of 8:20 PM ET Oct 14; CPI details; Fed meeting Oct 27-28) - Reuters via za.investing.com, oil settlement Oct 14 (Brent $106.06, WTI $95.09) - Nasdaq.com and Earnings Whispers earnings calendars Oct 15 - WSJ news archive Oct 14 (CPI 3.7%, Ukraine Starlink, Guilfoyle reporting); Democracy Now headlines Oct 14 (Guilfoyle resignation, Collins-Jackson debate, measles, Yemen, Ebola, Ukraine power) - Washington Post via Google News, Trump Alaska trip; CNN, Six Flags Goliath; Reuters world and domestic summaries Oct 14 (devdiscourse) - Vatican News/AP via Trends MCP digest, Pope Leo XIV surgery - The CODEW daily tech briefing Oct 14 (Nvidia Europe, CXMT); The Guardian technology Oct 14 (Uber Manchester, Nvidia UK pledge, IMF/BoE cyber warning); TechCrunch Oct 2026 (Netflix layoffs, YouTube Music, Deezer); BBN tech archive Oct 14 (eight states sue OpenAI, Microsoft-Japan scam takedown, Character.AI) - The Verge, "The AI race is back on"; ai-news-online.com and at-pulse.com Oct 14 (Gemini 4 Argon pricing, rankings); theairankings.com (OpenAI engineer arrest); Forward Future (Anthropic distillation defenses); The Morning Build (Anthropic false tip disclosure, X subscription bundle) - BleepingComputer (CISA Ivanti CVE-2026-104935; Cisco SEG CVE-2026-76519); Cybernews (Ivanti unpatched flaw); The Hacker News (Collabora CODE CVE-2026-110447) - Harry's X home timeline (@elonmusk, @levelsio, @BasedMikeLee, @Cernovich, @VivekGRamaswamy, @prestonjbyrne, @tylerbowyer, @micsolana, @TrungTPhan), read Oct 14 evening - londonderryhistory.org events;
